how_to_apply: Download the advertisement and application proforma from the AIIMS Raipur website: www.aiimsraipur.edu.in
Fill in the application proforma completely, including personal details, category, educational qualification, and registration details.
Pay the applicable application fee (General/OBC/EWS candidates only) via NEFT to the AIIMS Raipur account specified in the Application Fee section, and note the transaction details.
Submit the duly filled application through the official Google Form: forms.gle/6Wa9sb2i66mDqvMZ9
Attach the completed application proforma (downloaded from the website) along with the Google Form submission.

Ensure your application is submitted before the closing date of 16.08.2026. Only online applications through the Google Form will be accepted; applications through any other mode will not be considered.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC is as per Central Government rules, and 4% reservation applies for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis. The appointment can be terminated at any time, by either side, with one month's notice or payment of one month's salary, without assigning any reason. The appointee must serve on a whole-time basis at AIIMS and cannot accept any other paid or unpaid assignment, nor engage in private practice during the contract period. Canvassing of any kind will lead to disqualification. Possessing the minimum prescribed qualification does not automatically entitle a candidate to selection. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts can lead to removal from service and further action as deemed fit. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of courts of law at Raipur (C.G.). Candidates are advised to regularly check the AIIMS Raipur website for updates on shortlisting, written test/interview schedules, and admit cards, as no separate individual intimation will be sent.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 121 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) posts are available across 39 departments at AIIMS Raipur. The department-wise, category-wise break-up is given below. Vacancies are provisional and subject to variation as per Government of India rules and requirements. Notes: As per guidelines, EWS posts are not carried forward or treated as backlog vacancies if unfilled; other category candidates may provisionally apply for such a post, but will be considered only as UR candidates if the EWS seat is not otherwise filled. Candidates applying for clinical departments may also appear for interview for the Trauma & Emergency Department, subject to their willingness.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Eligibility
content_sections.text: A postgraduate medical degree, viz. MD/MS/DNB/Diploma, in the respective discipline from a recognised University/Institute. For School of Public Health: A postgraduate medical degree, viz. MD/DNB in Community Medicine/PSM, from a recognised University/Institute. For Dentistry: A postgraduate degree, i.e., MDS, in the concerned speciality. Candidates must be Indian Nationals. Age and other qualifications/experience will be counted as on the date of interview. Only candidates who have been declared successful in their qualifying degree exam, and who will be completing or are likely to complete their tenure on or before 31.08.2026, will be eligible. If the qualifying exam result is declared after the interview, the candidature will stand cancelled and no claim for selection will be considered.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of the application form. The maximum permissible relaxations are as follows: To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

Applications without the prescribed fee (where applicable) will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: This is a fixed-tenure appointment under the Residency Scheme, not a regular/permanent post. The appointee will not be entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion, or other benefits available to regularly appointed Government servants. Senior Residents are entitled to leave at the rate of 2½ days for every completed month.

rows.details: Usual allowances, including Non-Practising Allowance (NPA), if applicable

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The interview date, time, and list of eligible candidates will be published on the AIIMS Raipur website. No individual intimation will be sent by post.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: Based on bio-data, educational qualification, and experience. The Search cum Selection Committee may shortlist candidates directly for interview. Written/Screening Test (if required): If a large number of applications are received for any post, a Screening Test (computer-based or offline) may be conducted; the syllabus, scheme, and method will be notified on the AIIMS Raipur website. Interview: Held only at AIIMS Raipur, Tatibandh, G.E. Road, Raipur (C.G.) 492099. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Final Selection: Made entirely on the basis of the interview. The decision of the Executive Director & CEO, AIIMS Raipur, is final and binding. Candidates must download their Admit Card from the AIIMS Raipur website, as no admit card will be sent by post. The offer of appointment, when made, will be provisional and subject to verification of educational and personal credentials by the competent authority, and subject to the candidate being declared medically fit by a competent Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents with their application, and produce originals along with photocopies at the time of interview for verification: Certificate for Date of Birth (Class X or XII Certificate) MBBS Mark Sheets (all semesters) MBBS Degree Internship completion certificate Attempt certificates MCI/NMC/State Council registration MD/MS/DNB/PG Diploma certificate SC/ST/OBC/PH certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable) Experience certificate (if any) No Objection Certificate (if any) — mandatory for candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institutions Copies of any other relevant documents Category certificate requirements: OBC-NCL candidates must submit an OBC-NCL certificate (Annexure-A format) based on income for FY 2024-25, along with a creamy-layer exclusion declaration, issued on or after 01.04.2026. EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate (Annexure-C format) valid for 2026-27, as per the DoPT O.M. dated 31.01.2019. SC/ST/OBC certificates (Annexure-A & B formats) must be issued by a Tehsildar or above rank authority as prescribed by the Government of India.

Candidates working in Central/State Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Institutions must submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview. faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification (Advt. No. 9/327/2026/Recruit./Reg./AIIMSRPR/2120) by AIIMS Raipur for recruitment to 121 Senior Resident (Non-Academic) posts under the Government of India Residency Scheme, for a tenure of up to 3 years.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 121 posts: UR (44), OBC (37), SC (20), ST (13), and EWS (7), including 4 PwBD posts, across 39 departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 16.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB/Diploma) in the relevant discipline. For School of Public Health, MD/DNB in Community Medicine/PSM is required; for Dentistry, an MDS in the concerned speciality is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 years as on the last date of receipt of the application, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and further relaxation for PwBD and Ex-servicemen categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC/EWS candidates must pay ₹1,000/- via NEFT. Women, SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-servicemen candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident (Non-Academic)?
faq.answer: The pay is ₹67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01, as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances, including NPA where applicable. As a fixed-tenure Residency Scheme post, it does not carry benefits like Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, or Seniority/Promotion.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Raipur Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on shortlisting from bio-data (with a written/screening test if applications are large in number), followed by an interview at AIIMS Raipur. No TA/DA is paid for the interview.
